boot_gate_finding: 2026-10-22 OBSERVED: without license sectors (0..15) the OpenBIOS shello CDChecker loops forever (identical cube animation across Tetrade/Nortis/PSXMC; game EXE never reaches RAM, ~72KB nonzero). This SUPERSEDES the earlier 'OpenBIOS kernel pad defect' diagnosis on the beetle backend: padbuff absence was a symptom of the game never running, not a pad-path defect. PCSX-Redux-side observation is stale pending re-test under the same fix.
